'''Mason Johnson Profit the Resurrection''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Mason Johnson]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14561">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14561 Profit the Resurrection], DeckTech (Mason "Palleon" Johnson, 13 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14561/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14561/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mason Johnson]]
* '''Published:''' 13 March 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Profit the Resurrection''

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

== Original post ==

'''Profit the Resurrection'''
* '''Author:''' Mason "Palleon" Johnson
* '''Published:''' March 13, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Profit is so unexpeted you can actually win with it

=== Strategy ===

Edit@@@@@@@ Character Count Should by 24 not 25

This is the First Profit I have ever built, so I don't no all of the deatails on how to play it, but it is pretty simple. Just Free Han, Get You Eloms and Mains out. Drain for tons, and retrieve with the Wind Chimes. If they come down destroy them in battles and you can win

More Strategy will be added, after I find the time to play test thid deck a few times.

Thanks for Reading and Reviewing
